_comment: Cockpit displays and dashboard in fast flight, with the game's own settings (TSR, Nanite on, camera shake): they must stay sharp. They broke up while the interior was Nanite (wrong motion vectors; sharp with r.Nanite 0), now it is not (no_nanite_parts in the setup). The console field runs console commands before a shot, for comparing settings; they stay set for the next shots. Run: Tools/Shots.ps1 -Preset display_sharpness
